args.message: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money, per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP` in `round_money`, causing the nightly build to fail since `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`) per FIN-212.

## Change
- Switched the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix-bankers-rounding` @ 08d3cd5986: **passed**.

Reviewer: alex
args.head: fix-bankers-rounding
